items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: And I made an arrangement on "Swing High, Swing Low," and one on "Christopher Columbus."

ctx.x: So I got Les Hite's band and my band and put them together. Had ten saxophones, ten brass, used four guitar players and two tuba players. And I made an arrangement on "Swing High, Swing Low," and one on "Christopher Columbus." And we rehearsed for two weeks and we went into this parade.
Now, what year is this, '36? Because Christopher Columbus came out in '36?

This might have been '37. This probably was '37. And we marched down Broadway in L.A. and the crowd just followed us all the way to City Hall. And we won this prize. I led the parade with my clarinet, let the band. And we won the prize.
